text:
anya: Heads-up: canary for release/v2.7.0 shows embeddings.p95 jump immediately post-merge. Deploy-bot triggered. Holding promotion.
deploy-bot: SAFETY_HOLD: embeddings.p95 > 2x baseline. Action suggested: investigate, pin, or rollback.
sam: Do we let deploy-bot auto-rollback? We risk touching dedicated/reserved pools for a few enterprise customers.
sales-amy: Please avoid flipping dedicated pools without sales heads-up; we have a customer webinar in 2h.
anya: OK manual operator action. Ops, pin hosted embeddings to previous stable tag `v2.6.4`, keep 1% canary on v2.7.0, and suppress auto-rollback. Reason: "post-merge p95 spike"
ops-runner: Running:
```
routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.6.4 --canary 1 --reason "post-merge p95 spike"
```
ops-runner: Pin applied: hosted embeddings 99% -> v2.6.4, 1% canary on v2.7.0. Auto-rollback suppressed.
sre-jen: Noted metric correlation with kv_cache.evictions & small GC increase on new runtime. Opening INF-2007. Adding KV-compat regression test to CI.
kate: Drafting customer advisory: "Temporary routing pin for embeddings to previous version due to elevated latency; monitoring." Need legal review before broad send.
legal-bot: Reviewed. Language OK, avoid SLA wording. Approve send to customers with notice: "next update in 30m"
release-doug: Also add a short note in release notes: "v2.7.0 embeddings paused for further validation; fix in progress."
anya: Ops, run a quick smoke and quality sample on pinned traffic. If latency returns to baseline and quality holds, we keep suppression for 45m and prepare hotfix branch.
ops-runner: Smoke results: auth ok, embeddings-create latency back to baseline (p95 ~210ms), sample quality 98/100. No functional errors.
sam: Rollback criteria proposal: if embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> execute targeted rollback for embeddings to v2.6.3 and notify customers. Agree?
sre-jen: Agree. INF-2007 owner will coordinate ML runtime patch.
anya: OK lock it in. Keep suppression until hotfix validated. Sales & legal, we'll ping you before any plan that touches dedicated pools. Closing loop for now; reopen if telemetry changes. :thumbsup:
